title: The Global Empirical NTK: Self-Referential Bias and Dimensionality of Gradient Descent Learning
summary: In training a neural network with gradient descent (GD), each iteration induces a linear operator that governs first-order updates to a model's internal state variables. We define this operator as the Global Empirical Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK). In finite-width networks, the NTK is typically intractable to form, leading prior work to focus on restrictive settings such as tracking outputs only or taking infinite-width limits.
